appDesc.message: Export Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, Meta AI, WhatsApp Web and self-hosted OpenWebUI chats to clean Markdown. One click, 100% local.

slogan.message: Draw from every AI; grow your own intelligence.

optScrollHint.message: Uncheck to export only the visible content

optZipHint.message: Otherwise images are inlined into the Markdown

optSpoolHint.message: Saves an extra plaintext .md copy to Downloads/ai-chat-spool/ for MCP tools. Unencrypted, never auto-deleted.

patternDefaultEmpty.message: Default: none — add your deployment URL

openwebuiHelp.message: OpenWebUI is self-hosted: add your instance URL and grant access first.

errInvalidUrl.message: Enter a valid URL, e.g. https://chat.example.com/

errPermissionDenied.message: Permission was not granted; the extension cannot run there.

errInject.message: Could not inject the content script: $1

errTabQuery.message: Could not access the current tab: $1

errNoUrl.message: Could not read the current page URL.

errNoSiteMatch.message: This page doesn't match any enabled site. Open a supported AI chat page, or add/enable it under Site configuration below.

errNoResponse.message: No response from the content script. Refresh the page and try again.

errAdapterDisabled.message: $1 is disabled in Site configuration. Re-enable it in the popup.

errNoConversation.message: No conversation found. Make sure the $1 page has finished loading.
